opening.argument: The presentation is structured as a historical and legal account of the Ayodhya dispute: its title identifies a detailed timeline from 1528 to 2020, while the narration explains the dispute's development, twists and turns, and culmination in the 2019 Supreme Court judgment. It further anchors that chronology by stating that the Court gave its verdict on 9th November 2019. This documentary-style treatment presents dated events and legal proceedings, without offering money-related benefits, requesting credentials or required participation, or showing an apparent financial solicitation or transaction flow.
